_readme: Every real tool result in this video is a SLOT. status 'placeholder' renders skeletons + a PLACEHOLDER ribbon. To insert a real result: put the value in the slot, set status to 'verified', set source, run `python3 build.py`. Nothing else changes. Never mark a slot verified without the real transcript/CSV/recording on disk.

hook_csv.note: Opening shot: the real exported spreadsheet (masked person fields). Needs the real CSV.

install_out.note: Real output of /plugin install (or /plugin status showing vibe-prospecting installed).

whoami_out.note: Real `vpai whoami` result (exit 0 = ready). Hide login URL/keys.

prompt_run.note: Screen recording of Claude Code receiving the exact prompt.

stats_count.note: Real fetch-entities-statistics total (matches in the database).

sample_table.note: Real 5-company sample (company names, domains are allowed; person data masked).

credit_note.note: Exact credit/cost message from the tool.

enrich_profile.note: One real enriched record, person-level fields masked. Empty fields show 'Not available'.

final_csv.note: Real CSV opened in a spreadsheet (masked).

final_count.note: Real number of records in the CSV (NOT 100 unless it really is).
